  {P} _ b Hb Hinh =>

  have h₂ : BddBelow S := ⟨b, by

    -- Prove that `b` is a lower bound for `S`.

    exact h₄⟩

        -- Use the fact that the set is bounded below and inhabited.

          <;> simp_all [Set.Nonempty]
          <;> aesop
        refine' ⟨sInf S, _⟩
        exact ⟨h₆.1, h₆.2⟩
      exact h₅
    obtain ⟨lb, hlb₁, hlb₂⟩ := h₄

  obtain ⟨lb, hlb₁, hlb₂⟩ := h₃
